records.question: Mark has two pets, a hare that runs 10 feet/second and a turtle that crawls 1 foot/second. If they're going to run a 20 foot-race, how much of a head start (in seconds) does the turtle need to finish in a tie?
records.response:
The hare will finish the race in 20 / 10 = 2 seconds.
The turtle will need to finish the race in 20 / 1 = 20 seconds.
The turtle needs a head start of 20 - 2 = 18 seconds.
#### 18

records.question: Jimmy needs to score at least 50 points to pass to the next class. He earned 20 points for each of the 3 exams he wrote but lost 5 points during the school year for bad behavior. How many more points can Jimmy lose and still be able to pass the next class?
records.response:
Jimmy earned 20 points per exam for 3 exams, so he earned 20*3 = 60 points.
He lost 5 points for bad behavior, so he has 60-5 = 55 points.
To pass the next class, he needs at least 50 points, so he can lose 55-50 = 5 more points.
#### 5
